output_format_requirements: Return the Boolean token True or False.
full_credit_requirements: Return True exactly when all courses can be completed while satisfying every prerequisite pair (a_i, b_i), meaning course b_i must be taken before course a_i.
Return False otherwise, including when the prerequisite constraints make completion of all courses impossible.

evidence.quote: Return True if you can finish all courses considering the prerequisites, or False otherwise.
prerequisites[i] = (a_i, b_i) indicates that you must first take course b_i if you want to take course a_i
